solution: Expand: \(x^8-x^7-x^6+x^5+3x^4-4x^3-2x^2+4x-1\). Sign analysis gives simple roots at \(x=-1\) and \(x\approx0.33\), and a double (touch) root at \(x=1\). Distinct real roots \(=3\).
note: root of the octic is about 0.332, not 0.4; count 3 and key unchanged.

solution: \(ax^{2}-2bx+15=0\) has a repeated root, so its discriminant \(4b^{2}-60a=0\Rightarrow b^{2}=15a,\) and \(\alpha=\tfrac{b}{a}=\tfrac{b}{b^{2}/15}=\tfrac{15}{b}.\) For \(x^{2}-2bx+21=0:\ \alpha+\beta=2b,\ \alpha\beta=21.\) From \(\tfrac{15}{b}+\tfrac{21b}{15}=2b\) we get \(b=\pm5\), so \(\alpha=\pm3,\ \beta=\pm7.\) Hence \(\alpha^{2}+\beta^{2}=9+49=58.\)
note: b = -5 also solves it (alpha = -3, beta = -7); alpha^2 + beta^2 = 58 either way. Key B unchanged.
